findings.location: Body, “The dearth in our day” paragraph
findings.source_quote: To suggest that “all” means for youth (and older ones as well) to renounce sports and pleasure seeking may get a person tagged as “legalist.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “mwanasheria” with “mtu anayeshikilia sheria kupita kiasi” or another Kiswahili rendering of “legalist.”
findings.translation_quote: Kudokeza kwamba “vyote” humaanisha vijana (na hata wazee) waache michezo na kutafuta anasa kunaweza kumfanya mtu aitwe “mwanasheria.”

findings.source_quote: But this Spirit is given to no one except he first submit himself to the cross and the chastisement of the Lord.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Roho huyu hawi mtu yeyote isipokuwa ajitiishe kwanza” with “Hakuna mtu anayepewa Roho huyu isipokuwa ajitiishe kwanza.”
findings.translation_quote: Lakini Roho huyu hawi mtu yeyote isipokuwa ajitiishe kwanza kwa msalaba na adhabu ya Bwana.
